name: BetterContact
summary: Waterfall work email and mobile phone enrichment across many providers, lead and company search, and person and company profiles.

api_key.description: A BetterContact API key (app.bettercontact.rocks/api_requests). Sent in the X-API-Key header.

notes: Credits are charged per valid data point returned, once per result however many providers were tried; every result carries credits_consumed and credits_left.
100 requests a minute per key (200 on Pro or from 1,000 monthly credits), across all endpoints.
Webhook delivery is left out: poll the *_result endpoints instead.

endpoints.name: Get credit balance
endpoints.summary: Credits left for the organization behind the key.
notes: Free and exempt from the rate limit. The balance is shared across the organization.

endpoints.name: Look up a person profile
endpoints.summary: A person's LinkedIn profile and current company, without email or phone.

linkedin_url.description: Public LinkedIn profile URL; enough alone.

company.description: Company name; complements company_domain, cannot replace it.

notes: A read over POST, answered synchronously. 0.1 credit per profile found; no match is a free 404.

endpoints.name: Look up a company profile
endpoints.summary: One company's profile by domain or LinkedIn URL.
notes: A read over POST, answered synchronously. Free.

endpoints.name: Start a waterfall email and phone enrichment
endpoints.summary: Finds verified work emails and mobile phones for 1 to 100 leads across many providers; answers with a request id.

data.description: 1-100 leads: {first_name, last_name, company_domain or company, linkedin_url, custom_fields}.

enrich_email_address.description: Find the work email (the default when no enrich_* flag is set).

enrich_phone_number.description: Find the mobile phone; needs the phone add-on, else 402. Pass linkedin_url for best results.

enrich_profile.description: Also return the LinkedIn profile; needs linkedin_url.

verify_catch_all.description: Run the catch-all verification layer; needs its add-on.

timeout_seconds.description: Stop the waterfall after this long and keep what was found.

notes: Starts a billed job: credits are spent only per verified email or phone returned (undeliverable or not found is free); nothing else changes in the account.
Asynchronous: poll bettercontact.contacts.enrich_result with the returned id. Submissions are not idempotent: a retried POST is charged again.

endpoints.name: Get waterfall enrichment results
endpoints.summary: Emails, phones and statuses found for each lead of an enrichment request.
notes: Free. Answers 202 with no data while running; read status and stop only at terminated (on_hold means credits ran out mid-run: top up, do not resubmit).

endpoints.name: Start a lead search
endpoints.summary: Finds people by company criteria (domain, industry, location, size, funding, hiring, tech) and person criteria (title, seniority, department, location); answers with a request id.

filters.description: Criteria, each {include: [...], exclude: [...]}: company, company_industry, company_hq_location, company_technologies, company_headcount_min/max, lead_job_title, lead_seniority, lead_department, lead_location, ...; closed lists are in Taxonomies.

limit.description: Leads to return, 1-200; use with offset to page.

offset.description: Leads to skip; only with limit.

max_leads.description: Leads to return without paging, 1-200, default 100.

notes: A read over POST, free: the search spends no credits (its enrich_email_address and enrich_phone_number flags, which do, are left out of this entry).
Runs in the background: poll bettercontact.leads.search_result with the request_id.

endpoints.name: Get lead search results
endpoints.summary: The leads a lead search found.
notes: Free. Answers 202 with no data while running; read status and stop only at terminated (on_hold means credits ran out mid-run: top up, do not resubmit).

endpoints.name: Start a company search
endpoints.summary: Finds companies by domain, industry, HQ location, headcount, revenue, funding, technologies and hiring; answers with a request id.

filters.description: Criteria, each {include: [...]}: company, company_industry, company_hq_location, company_technologies, company_keywords, company_headcount_min/max, revenue_ranges, last_funding_round_names, job_post_titles, is_public, ...

notes: Starts a billed job: 0.1 credit per company returned, each page charged on its own; no match is free.
Asynchronous: poll bettercontact.company.search_result with the request_id. Domains must be lowercase.

endpoints.name: Get company search results
endpoints.summary: The companies a company search found, with the total match count.
notes: Free. Answers 202 with no data while running; read status and stop only at terminated (on_hold means credits ran out mid-run: top up, do not resubmit).
